primitives.name: Path Optimization

primitives.name: Accidental Press

primitives.assumptions: Assumes uniform distribution of movement within the search space and binary trigger response.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when the agent learns to avoid the accidental trigger, reducing its occurrence rate to zero.

layer2.mapping: The accidental press mechanism mirrors the exploration-exploitation tradeoff in multi-armed bandits. In GSI, this maps to Thompson sampling for uncertain outcomes. In GSE, it corresponds to stochastic action selection policies.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency count of unintended trigger activations per unit time.
